context_rules: Only declared workflow/metadiscourse contexts can be qualified neutral. The list is finite, versioned and not a general semantic guarantee.

At most one leading context followed by comma/colon/em-dash and one trailing context after comma and before the terminal question mark. Case/whitespace variants accepted. No internal parenthetical deletion, no arbitrary phrase stripping.

An expected_contexts item is NEUTRAL_CONTEXT with exact original UTF8 [start,end), excerpt includes the consumed delimiter and surrounding whitespace: leading interval includes prefix through space after delimiter; trailing interval includes comma through whitespace immediately before ?. Sorted original order.

Context cannot mention catalog subject, other requirement/document/action outside declared grammar, negation, condition, lot/version/date/financial information. Any such segment must NOT be certified neutral. Raw recognizer may still prove legitimate explicit lot scope without any neutral context (e.g. ordinary lot prefix); never erase or invent scope.
Financial guard and invalid input budget are checked on the WHOLE ORIGINAL query first, even context mentions/citations. Financial refusal has null intent and no context evidence.

Raw query remains authoritative and is never passed rewritten to retrieval/encoder. An internal grammatical view may replace only proven context intervals by whitespace of identical character positions; remap all view UTF8 offsets through character positions back to original bytes, validate excerpts and original hash, retain every context in the output.

Covered main intent retains exactly one SUBJECT/DEMAND and uniqueLOT if proven. Context evidence is separate from intent anchors. Failure to validate any mapping or unproven removal => abstention, no fabricated anchor.

Contexts never establish source applicability or business truth; UNKNOWN remains. Underlying v2 safeguards for multiple subjects/demands/scope/negation/condition remain in force on every unqualified segment.
No context or unknown context is silently dropped as a fallback. No source reading, model, SQL, retrieval, active factory or API integration.

Abstention convention: quotations/metalinguistic/explicit response-instructions => UNKNOWN/NON_ACTIVE_REQUEST; plain declarative or unproved request without interrogative evidence => UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Preserve explicit subject/validlot and noDEMAND.

Without a catalog subject, an inversion pronoun by itself does NOT prove an unresolved reference. Explicit demonstrative/object-pronoun reference without antecedent => UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE; otherwise UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN_SUBJECT. Unknown qualifier keeps SUBJECT lexical span, subjectUNKNOWN. These changes are prospective v3 reasons, never reinterpret v1/v2 results.

Declared context qualification does not broaden the base lexical subject/demand inventory; cases requiring other main predicates are outside first context proof. New challenge targets this context treatment, with baselines compared on identical frozen cases only.
